final: WITH rating_avgs AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) as per_rating_avg FROM film WHERE replacement_cost IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(per_rating_avg) as overall_avg FROM rating_avgs), filtered AS (SELECT r.per_rating_avg, r.per_rating_avg - o.overall_avg as diff FROM rating_avgs r CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE r.per_rating_avg > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(per_rating_avg) as avg_per_rating_avg, AVG(diff) as avg_difference FROM filtered
